message.content:
This document describes **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for running very large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models on consumer and prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Core architecture**
- Runs GLM-5.3-Flash (321B params, ~18B active, 1M context) and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (748B) on local hardware.
- Tiered expert storage: hot experts in VRAM, next in pinned RAM, rest on NVMe SSD, moved dynamically per conversation.
- Auto-tunes to measured GPU/CPU/RAM
